nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Public counter of airdropped tokens declared in ESCBAirdropper (never written in the visible code).
Running total of tokens claimed through airdrops and crane withdrawals.
Static amount of tokens sent to each recipient in a static airdrop.
Mapping address => bool guarding against double allocations; written after external token transfers.
Mapping address => bool whitelist of addresses allowed to call getFreeTokens.
Mapping address => bool of accounts authorised to run airdrops and maintain the crane list.
ERC20 token contract whose transfer/balanceOf functions are called by this contract.
Flag gating the getFreeTokens crane withdrawal.
Ownable() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner).
Owner-only transfer of contract ownership to newOwner.
Constructor initialising totalClaimed, amountOfTokens and the ERC20 token address.
Agent-only airdrop of a static amountOfTokens to each address in _recipients; loops and performs external token.transfer.
Agent-only airdrop of dynamic per-recipient amounts; loops and performs external token.transfer.
Owner-only toggling of airdrop agent authorisation.
Owner-only return of remaining tokens via external token.transfer to owner.
Owner-only replacement of the ERC20 token contract address.
Owner-only update of the static airdrop amount.
Owner-only enabling/disabling of the crane mechanism.
View helper returning token.balanceOf(this).
Agent-only bulk insertion of addresses into the crane whitelist.
Crane withdrawal: transfers amountOfTokens to msg.sender if whitelisted and not already paid.
onlyAirdropAgent modifier: require(airdropAgent[msg.sender]).
whenCraneEnabled modifier: require(craneEnabled).
SafeMath.mul: multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div: integer division truncating the quotient.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction with underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add: addition with overflow assertion.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address used for ownership, agent authorisation and crane withdrawals.
External call token.transfer(_recipients[i], amountOfTokens) inside airdrop, executed before the tokensReceived state update.
External call token.transfer(_recipients[i], _amount[i]) inside airdropDynamic, executed before state finalisation.
External call token.transfer(owner, remainingTokens()) inside reset.
External call token.transfer(msg.sender, amountOfTokens) inside getFreeTokens; tokensReceived is set afterwards.
External call token.balanceOf(this) inside remainingTokens.
Unchecked arithmetic totalClaimed.add(amountOfTokens * _recipients.length) in airdrop; the multiplication is raw uint256 math.
Accumulation totalClaimed.add(_amount[i]) inside the airdropDynamic loop.
Accumulation totalClaimed.add(amountOfTokens) inside getFreeTokens.
Arithmetic c = a + b with assert(c >= a) inside SafeMath.add.
Arithmetic c = a * b with assert(c / a == b) inside SafeMath.mul.
Arithmetic a - b with assert(b <= a) inside SafeMath.sub.
newOwner address parameter of transferOwnership.
_amount parameter (static airdrop amount) of the ESCBAirdropper constructor.
_tokenAddress parameter of the ESCBAirdropper constructor.
_recipients array parameter of airdrop.
_recipients array parameter of airdropDynamic.
_amount array parameter of airdropDynamic.
_agentAddress parameter of setAirdropAgent.
state boolean parameter of setAirdropAgent.
_tokenAddress parameter of changeTokenAddress.
_amount parameter of changeTokenAmount.
_status boolean parameter of changeCraneStatus.
_recipients array parameter of addAddressToCraneList.
Loop index i of the airdrop for-loop.
Loop index i of the airdropDynamic for-loop.
Loop index i of the addAddressToCraneList for-loop.

edges.reason: The Ownable constructor derives the initial owner from the attacker-controllable msg.sender.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable, defining the privileged account.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable to authorise the caller.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner, the entire access control gate.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
The newOwner parameter is assigned to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership mutates owner, changing who passes onlyOwner.
Constructor parameter _amount initialises amountOfTokens.
Constructor parameter _tokenAddress is cast to ERC20 and stored in token.
Constructor resets totalClaimed to zero.
airdrop is restricted by the onlyAirdropAgent modifier.
onlyAirdropAgent indexes airdropAgent with msg.sender.
onlyAirdropAgent reads the airdropAgent mapping for authorisation.
The _recipients array drives the airdrop loop and its length feeds totalClaimed.
airdrop requires tokensReceived[recipient] to be false before paying.
airdrop flips tokensReceived to true inside the loop, after the external transfer.
airdrop executes the external token.transfer call for each recipient.
The guard state tokensReceived is only written after the external transfer returns.
airdrop updates totalClaimed with the arithmetic expression at the end of the loop.
amountOfTokens is multiplied by the recipient count in the totalClaimed update.
_recipients.length participates in the raw multiplication feeding totalClaimed.
totalClaimed is the accumulator that is read and rewritten.
Loop index i controls iteration of the airdrop loop.
airdropDynamic is restricted by the onlyAirdropAgent modifier.
The _recipients array drives the dynamic airdrop loop.
The _amount array supplies the per-recipient transfer amounts.
airdropDynamic requires tokensReceived[recipient] to be false.
airdropDynamic flips tokensReceived to true after the external call inside the loop.
airdropDynamic performs the external token.transfer call.
tokensReceived is updated only after the external transfer returns.
airdropDynamic accumulates totalClaimed with _amount[i] each iteration.
_amount[i] is added to totalClaimed.
totalClaimed is the accumulator mutated in the loop.
Loop index i controls iteration of the airdropDynamic loop.
setAirdropAgent is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_agentAddress is used as the key written into the airdropAgent mapping.
The state boolean is used as the value written into the airdropAgent mapping.
setAirdropAgent grants or revokes airdrop privileges.
reset is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
reset performs an external token.transfer to the owner.
The owner address is the recipient of the remaining tokens.
reset calls remainingTokens to compute the transfer amount.
remainingTokens queries the stored ERC20 token contract.
remainingTokens performs an external balanceOf call on the token.
changeTokenAddress is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_tokenAddress replaces the token contract, redirecting all future transfers.
changeTokenAddress mutates the token state variable.
changeTokenAmount is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_amount becomes the per-recipient amount used by airdrop and getFreeTokens.
changeTokenAmount mutates amountOfTokens.
changeCraneStatus is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_status controls the craneEnabled flag.
changeCraneStatus mutates craneEnabled.
addAddressToCraneList is restricted by the onlyAirdropAgent modifier.
The _recipients array drives the crane list insertion loop.
addAddressToCraneList writes true into craneList for each recipient.
The function checks tokensReceived before whitelisting an address.
Loop index i controls iteration of the crane list loop.
getFreeTokens is gated by the whenCraneEnabled modifier.
whenCraneEnabled reads the craneEnabled flag.
msg.sender is checked against craneList and tokensReceived and is the recipient of the transfer.
getFreeTokens requires craneList[msg.sender] to be true.
getFreeTokens requires tokensReceived[msg.sender] to be false.
tokensReceived is set to true after the external transfer, leaving a reentrancy window.
getFreeTokens performs an external token.transfer to the caller.
The double-spend guard is written only after the external call completes.
The external transfer sends tokens to msg.sender.
getFreeTokens accumulates totalClaimed after the transfer.
amountOfTokens is added to totalClaimed.
totalClaimed is the accumulator that is read and rewritten.
airdrop invokes transfer on the stored token contract.
airdropDynamic invokes transfer on the stored token contract.
getFreeTokens invokes transfer on the stored token contract.
SafeMath.add performs the checked addition c = a + b.
SafeMath.mul performs the multiplication that can overflow before the assert.
SafeMath.sub performs the subtraction guarded by assert(b <= a).
The airdrop totalClaimed update is performed through SafeMath.add.
The airdropDynamic accumulation is performed through SafeMath.add.
The getFreeTokens accumulation is performed through SafeMath.add.
The amountOfTokens * _recipients.length expression is raw multiplication that SafeMath does not cover.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter exists only to feed the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
_amount is a constructor argument whose only role is to initialise amountOfTokens.
_tokenAddress is a constructor argument whose only role is to set the token state variable.
_recipients is the loop input and length source for the airdrop function.
_recipients is the loop input for the airdropDynamic function.
_amount supplies the transfer value and totalClaimed increment inside airdropDynamic.
_agentAddress is only used as the mapping key written by setAirdropAgent.
state is only used as the mapping value written by setAirdropAgent.
_tokenAddress is only used to overwrite the token state variable.
_amount is only used to overwrite the amountOfTokens state variable.
_status is only used to overwrite the craneEnabled flag.
_recipients is the loop input for the crane list insertion function.
The loop index i is scoped entirely to the airdrop for-loop.
The loop index i is scoped entirely to the airdropDynamic for-loop.
The loop index i is scoped entirely to the addAddressToCraneList for-loop.
